beats.say: About five to seven metres. That's how high the sea can surge where the Krishna and Godavari meet the Bay.
India's weather office calls it a very high risk zone.
For Murasu, it warned of a surge up to one and a half metres, worst around Bapatla and Krishna.
Two river mouths. After a cyclone in nineteen ninety, satellites saw water still standing in the Krishna delta eleven days later.
beats.cap: May 1990: standing water seen after 11 days

beats.say: In nineteen seventy-seven, a cyclone struck Divi Seema. About ten thousand people died. The surge was blamed.
beats.cap: 1977 Divi Seema: about 10,000 dead · blamed on the surge
